messages:
jules: Shiproom asked for a short stability-first rollout proposal for EU private model swap. Key constraints: tenant stability, decay rules, and fallback ownership.
anya: Proposal: tenant-hash cohorts with per-tenant cookie (48h), wave ramp 3%->12%->30%, per-tenant rps cap 50, and a circuit budget to avoid noisy neighbors.
mike: Circuit budget = 2 circuits per 60m window. If exceeded, tenant exposure=0, tag rollback_reason and start cooldown 120m. Manual review for reinstatement.
ops-bot: runbook reminder: any private rollout that touches >5% tenants needs oncall pinned and attached rollback playbook.
anya: Soft-fallback chain: quantized -> token-cap -> prompt-simplify -> global-kill. Infra owns quantized variants; product owns prompt templates.
eval-bot: A/B probes: micro AB during warmup (500 sessions, 50/50), quick sanity at +20m, full 1k AB at +3h. Hallucination delta threshold = +1.1.
jules: Telemetry gates: kms_ok, p95_gate (<= baseline*1.25), ab_hallucination. KMS preflight scheduled at 2076543260. Fail -> automatic hold.
mike: Kill SLA: global flag flip <60s, private drain <120s target. Add tenant.rollback_reason and tenant.opt_in tags for audit.
anya: Flag proto snippet (compact):
```
flags.swap.stability_first = { cohort_fraction:0.03, cookie_ttl:"48h", per_tenant_rps:50, bump:[0.12 after 1h,0.30 after 4h], circuit_budget:{limit:2,window_mins:60,cooldown_mins:120}, fallback:["quantized","token_cap","prompt_simplify","global_kill"], telemetry:["kms_ok","p95_gate","ab_hallucination"] }
```
jules: Action items: mike implement circuit enforcement + tags, anya implement flag + fallback mapping, ops confirm KMS preflight, eval-bot prepare AB prompts. Timeline: KMS 2076543260, warmup 20m, quick sanity +20m, AB full +3h.
anya: If no objections to 3%->12%->30% cadence and circuits=2/window, thumbs up.
mike: :thumbsup:
eval-bot: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: /deploy canary --requires-approvals product,security
jules: Closing and moving to shiproom notes. Reopen if approvals or KMS preflight change.
